_note: Session 18 (Aaron: you had to stand on the right side of a tent to search it): the tents' search points are their centres, with a 3.2 m reach, so any side works. The abandoned campsite (M9.2; DESIGN.md "Abandoned campsite", agreed with Aaron in Session 15). Positions are in the campsite's own frame: from where the path from home enters the clearing, x metres to your right as you walk in, z metres ahead (the clearing's centre is z 0; the entrance is z = -radius). yaw: degrees, turning from facing ahead toward your right. car: the campers' car (vehicles.json types; the campsite's placement gives it a sure battery and no alarm), parked at the edge by the path. tents: kind a (an A-frame) or dome; slashed: torn open from the inside, the slit on its far side (found, not presented). searches: the hold-X search points, in the order a player meets them walking in: guaranteed items (camcorder: the lore item; shotgun: the gun, with `rounds` more shells; or a loot.json item with amount) and a rolled table (loot.json items, each rolled on its own). Session 16 (Aaron): the stick figures are gone (cluttered, and they floated); the dome tent's search point is its centre, reach 3 m, so any side works. Session 15b (Aaron): the camcorder is in the torn tent (deep in the camp) and the shotgun in the green dome tent; whichever comes first, the wave starts on the shotgun and the tape plays on the camcorder. props: set dressing (chairs, packs, the fire ring, blood, the ritual marks cut into trunks at the edge). wave: the zombies that burst from the treeline when the shotgun is taken: count, the spread of their arrival (seconds), and where they come from (arcs of the clearing's edge, in degrees in the campsite frame: 0 ahead, 90 to the right, -90 to the left; distance past the edge). Session 25 (Aaron: "more of a survival camping campsite, like Luke from Outdoor Boys would have, with the log wall around the fire"): every story beat and search kept, re-skinned: the three tents are tarp-and-pole lean-tos with bough beds (kind leanto; their open sides face the fire; the torn tent is the slashed shelter), a log reflector wall behind the fire (props.reflector: x, z, yaw, length, logs; solid), a pot on a tripod over the fire ring (props.tripod), the woodpile as the firewood stack. No axe in a stump (Session 19, Aaron: an axe you can't pick up reads as a weapon you should be able to).

dressing._note: Session 19 (style pass 2): set dressing with no colliders (small enough to walk through or step over), in the campsite's frame. scorch: a blackened ring round the fire. grate and pot: on the fire ring. woodpile, table (a camp stove on it), (Session 19, Aaron: the chopping stump and its axe taken out again: an axe you can't pick up reads as a weapon you should be able to), clothesline (two posts, a towel and a shirt), sleepingBag (spilling out of the torn tent's door), litter (tins, bottles, a paper plate).
